author: agent
text: Do NOT add Path.resolve() here, however tidy it looks. A venv's bin/python is normally a symlink to the base interpreter, so resolving it walks OUT of the venv: installing from .venv/bin/python resolved to /Library/Frameworks/.../bin/python3.13 and with_name("memway") then pointed at a DIFFERENT install at a DIFFERENT version. The first version of the path-pin fix shipped that and the hook ran the wrong tool with a straight face. absolute() is correct precisely because it does not follow symlinks. Discovered 2026-08-16 while writing test_the_hook_fires_with_no_venv_on_path (0.53.3).
